caption: The drawing consists of two separate images side by side on a beige background. On the left side, there is a simple, outlined drawing of a jug or vase with a single handle near the top. The jug is decorated with a blue, abstract, brushstroke pattern on its upper left side. On the right side, there is a square image featuring a central blue botanical or abstract form with thick, petal-like shapes radiating from a central stem. Above this form are some small blue uppercase letters and a number "2." The blue color appears soft and textured, and the background for this section is a muted brownish-gray. The overall composition separates the two drawings with ample margin space around each image.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
